youtube_title: Jesus... My Deadline Is The Day After Diwali | Ecclesiastes 4:6 #Shorts
youtube_description:
Jesus's Replies — an imagined reply from Jesus to a real, unspoken prayer.

His office set a release deadline the day after Diwali and he is missing the festival at home for it.

He: Jesus... my office set a deadline for the day after Diwali. I opened my laptop on the train home. 💻
He: Amma lit the lamps alone. I told her the release is important.
Jesus: You missed the puja for a file that will ship without your name remembered.
He: But if I don't deliver, I look replaceable. Rent doesn't pay itself.
Jesus: Your worth was never measured in overtime. Rest is obedience too, not laziness.

“Better one handful with tranquility than two handfuls with toil and pursuit of the wind.”
Ecclesiastes 4:6 (BSB)

The lamps need you more than the sprint does.

💬 When did work last eat a festival you cared about? 👇

An imagined reply. The Scripture is quoted as written.
